run_catch_human_agent: run the Catch human agent example with pygame and gRPC to play the Catch game
start_catch_grpc_server: start a Catch gRPC server using CatchEnvironmentService on localhost with a secure port
render_catch_window: render the Catch game board and reward onto a pygame window surface
create_and_join_dm_env_world: create and join a dm_env_rpc world using create_and_join_world with an RPC connection
destroy_dm_env_world: destroy a dm_env_rpc world by sending a DestroyWorldRequest with the world name
